category_feedback.specific_evidence: lesson_specific_materials lists 'Detective Dot and Tally puppets' as a required item with no optional fallback. Per the rubric, lessons that REQUIRE puppets are scored Level 2 because puppets are specialty items most G1 teachers do not have ready on any given day.
category_feedback.required_fix: Reword the puppet line as explicitly optional with a no-prep fallback, e.g., 'OPTIONAL: Detective Dot and Tally puppets — if available; otherwise point to a stuffed animal, hold up a chart-paper sketch, or just voice/gesture them.' Mirror this in minds_on/teacher_script so the lesson runs on voice and body alone.

summary: Strong D1.4 ordering lesson — position-not-count trap is a real Grade 1 misconception with concrete recovery moves (ordering boxes 1->N, count-first drill), and the worksheet's Parts 1-3 cleanly transfer the lesson skill across pictograph and tally formats. Blocked on instructional_balance only: lesson_specific_materials REQUIRES 'Detective Dot and Tally puppets' with no optional fallback. Reword the puppet line as optional with a no-prep alternative and the pair clears the gate.
